y-m-01-10.topic: Sandunan wasa da alwatika (idan gefuna sun haɗu)
y-m-01-10.goal: Nemo a mafitar Seohyeon dalilin da ya sa adadin sandunan wasan da ake buƙata ba ya ƙaruwa da adadi iri ɗaya yayin da alwatika ke ƙaruwa, sannan ka yi amfani da tsarin wajen hasashen yanayi mafi girma.
y-m-01-10.material:
Ka haɗa alwatika a jere da sandunan wasa. Alwatika maƙwabta suna raba sanda guda. Alwatika 1 na buƙatar sanduna 3, alwatika 2 suna buƙatar 5, alwatika 3 kuma 7.
Adadin alwatika | 1 | 2 | 3
Adadin sandunan wasa | 3 | 5 | 7
Seohyeon na son gano sanduna nawa ake buƙata ga siffar da aka haɗa alwatika 5.

y-m-01-01.topic: Kwatanta lambobi masu lambobi biyu (gurbin goma da gurbin ɗaya)
y-m-01-01.goal: Yi amfani da misalai domin duba lokacin da hanyar tantance girman lambobi masu lambobi biyu ta duba lambobin gurbin ɗaya kawai take yin kuskure, sannan ka faɗi wane gurbi ya kamata a fara dubawa wajen kwatanta girma.
y-m-01-01.material: Hajun yana buga wasa inda yake ƙirƙirar lambobi biyu masu lambobi biyu da katunan lambobi, sannan ya yi hasashen wanne ya fi girma. A cikin lamba mai lambobi biyu, lambar hagu ita ce “gurbin goma” (yawan ƙunshin 10), lambar dama kuma ita ce “gurbin ɗaya” (yawan ɗaiɗaikun guda ɗaya). Misali, a cikin 35, lambar goma ita ce 3, ta ɗaya kuma 5. A ƙasa ga yadda Hajun ya bayyana hanyarsa.

y-m-01-02.title: Me zai faru idan aka haɗa lamba odd da wata lamba odd?
y-m-01-02.topic: Jimillar lambobi odd da even (gwada haɗa su bibbiyu)
y-m-01-02.goal: Duba yadda tabbaci yake canzawa idan misalai suka ƙaru da kuma idan ka koyi dalili, sannan ka bi ra'ayin da ke bayyana da hanyar haɗa su bibbiyu dalilin da ya sa haɗa lambobi biyu odd yake ba da adadi even.
y-m-01-02.material: Idan ka haɗa ƙwallayen marmara biyu-biyu, idan guda ɗaya ya rage yawan ƙwallayen “odd” ne, idan kuma babu abin da ya rage “even” ne. 3 ƙunshi biyu guda ɗaya ne da ragowa ɗaya, saboda haka odd ne; 8 kuma ƙunshi biyu huɗu ne, saboda haka even ne. Seoa tana son gano ko haɗa adadin ƙwallayen marmara odd da wani adadi odd a wuri guda yana ba da jimillar ƙwallaye odd ne ko even.

y-m-01-02.thinking.2: Ƙirƙiri nau'i-nau'i da dama masu jimilla da aka bayar
y-m-01-02.prereq.0: Gwada haɗa su biyu-biyu (matakin aji na 1 zuwa 2)
y-m-01-02.prereq.1: Ma'anar odd da even (ko akwai wani abu da ya rage ko babu)
y-m-01-02.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi yadda tunaninka yake canzawa a duk lokacin da sabon bayani ya fito.
y-m-01-02.s.s1.hint.0: A kowane mataki, da farko yanke shawarar tunaninka cikin jimla guda, sannan ka kwatanta ko sabon bayanin yana ƙarfafa wannan tunani ko yana girgiza shi.
y-m-01-02.s.s1.hint.1: Bambance ko abin da ya fito “misali” ne ko “dalili”, sannan ka yi tunani wanne ne ya fi sauya tabbacin da kake da shi.
y-m-01-02.s.s1.st.0.info: Seoa ta haɗa ƙwallayen marmara 3 da 5 a wuri guda ta sami 8. 8 even ne.
y-m-01-02.s.s1.st.0.ask: Me kake tunani game da ra'ayin nan: “haɗa lamba odd da lamba odd yana ba da lamba even”?
y-m-01-02.s.s1.st.0.after: Misali guda yana taimaka maka ka kafa zato, amma ba ya tabbatar da kowane yanayi. Ka ƙara gwada shi da sauran lambobi odd.
y-m-01-02.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Da alama haɗa lambobi odd yana ba da lamba odd
y-m-01-02.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Sakamakon haɗa 3 da 5, wato 8, even ne. Wannan ra'ayin bai dace da wannan misalin ba.
y-m-01-02.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Yanzu na tabbata kullum even ne
y-m-01-02.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Wannan ra'ayin yana ɗaukar kowane yanayi daga misali guda. Ka duba ko ka gwada wasu lambobi odd ma.
y-m-01-02.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Misali guda ɗaya ne kawai, don haka ina son in kuma duba da sauran lambobi odd
y-m-01-02.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Wannan ra'ayin ya fahimci cewa misali guda ba zai gaya maka ko kullum haka yake ba.
y-m-01-02.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Da alama zai zama even, amma har yanzu ban tabbatar ba
y-m-01-02.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Wannan ra'ayin ya yi zato amma ya dakata kafin tabbatarwa.
y-m-01-02.s.s1.st.1.info: Seoa ta ƙara gwadawa. 1 da 1 sun zama 2, 7 da 9 sun zama 16, 11 da 13 sun zama 24, 21 da 35 kuma sun zama 56. Dukkansu lambobi ne masu even.
y-m-01-02.s.s1.st.1.after: Idan misalai da yawa sun yi aiki, imani yana ƙaruwa. Amma ba za ka iya gwada kowace lamba mara even ba, don haka mataki na gaba shi ne sanin dalilin da ya sa haka yake.
y-m-01-02.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Ba zan yarda da hakan ba saboda wasu misalai kaɗan sun yi aiki kawai.
y-m-01-02.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Wannan tunani yana raina amfanin tattara misalai. Idan misalai sun yi aiki, imani zai iya ƙaruwa.
y-m-01-02.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Haɗa lambobi marasa even wani lokaci yana ba da lamba mai even, wani lokaci kuma mara even.
y-m-01-02.s.s1.st.1.r.b: A cikin misalan da aka gwada, ba a taɓa samun lamba mara even ko sau ɗaya ba.
y-m-01-02.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Misalai da yawa sun yi aiki, don haka imani na cewa koyaushe lambar mai even ce ya ƙaru.
y-m-01-02.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Misalai sun taru kuma imani ya ƙaru. Amma har yanzu akwai yanayin da ba a gwada ba.
y-m-01-02.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Ban gwada kowane yanayi ba tukuna, don haka ina son sanin dalilin.
y-m-01-02.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Wannan tunani ya gane cewa ko da misalai sun yi yawa, tabbaci yana da iyaka idan ba ka san dalili ba.

y-m-01-02.s.s1.st.2.after: Bayanin yana amfani ne kawai da ra'ayin cewa 'idan aka haɗa su bibbiyu, ɗaya zai rage', ko da yawan marmara nawa ne; saboda haka ana iya amfani da shi ga manyan lambobi ma.
y-m-01-02.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Yana aiki ne kawai ga ƙananan lambobi; don manya sai an haɗa su a gani.
y-m-01-02.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Ka yi tunani ko bayanin yana canzawa bisa yawan marmara. Ka duba ko adadin marmaran da suka rage yana zama iri ɗaya idan lambobin sun ƙaru.
y-m-01-02.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Idan lambobin sun yi girma, marmara fiye da ɗaya na iya ragewa.
y-m-01-02.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Idan aka haɗa su bibbiyu, abin da zai rage ko dai 0 ne ko 1. Ba ya canzawa idan lambobin sun ƙaru.
y-m-01-02.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Wannan bayani bai gaya mana komai ba.
y-m-01-02.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Wannan tunani ya daina yanke hukunci ba tare da la'akari da lokacin da bayanin yake aiki ba.
y-m-01-02.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Marmara ɗaya ce kullum take ragewa, don haka za a iya amfani da shi ga manyan lambobi ma.
y-m-01-02.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Wannan tunani ya dogara da dalilin cewa 'ɗaya na ragewa a kowane lokaci', ba girman lambobin ba.
y-m-01-02.s.s1.st.3.info: Seoa ta haɗa tulin marmara uku masu adadi mara even (3, 5, da 7) ta samu 15. 15 lamba ce mara even.
y-m-01-02.s.s1.st.3.ask: Me ke faruwa idan aka haɗa tulin marmara uku masu adadi mara even? Ta yaya za ka yi amfani da ra'ayin baya?
y-m-01-02.s.s1.st.3.after: Idan marmara uku ne suka rage, biyu za su zama ma'aurata, ɗaya kuma ya rage. Don haka jimillar ba even ba ce. Idan ka san dalili, za ka iya hasashen sababbin yanayi ba tare da tattara misalai ba.
y-m-01-02.s.s1.st.3.o.a: A baya, haɗa lambobi marasa even ya ba da lamba mai even, don haka kamar wannan karon ma lambar mai even za a samu.
y-m-01-02.s.s1.st.3.r.a: Wannan tunani ya ɗauko sakamakon tulin biyu kai tsaye ya kai shi tulin uku. Ka ƙirga adadin marmaran da suka rage.
y-m-01-02.s.s1.st.3.o.b: Kamar dai koyaushe lamba mara even za a samu, ko tulin nawa aka haɗa.
y-m-01-02.s.s1.st.3.r.b: Da tulin biyu lambar mai even ce aka samu. Ka duba ko sakamakon zai iya canzawa bisa adadin tulin.
y-m-01-02.s.s1.st.3.o.c: Tulin biyu suna ba da lamba mai even, saboda haka ƙara wani tulin zai ba da lamba mara even kamar dai.
y-m-01-02.s.s1.st.3.r.c: Wannan tunani ya ci gaba da amfani da dalilin da aka koya a baya ga sabon yanayi.
y-m-01-02.s.s1.st.3.o.d: Ta gwada ƙarin misalai ne kawai zan iya sani.
y-m-01-02.s.s1.st.3.r.d: Gwada ƙarin misalai ma hanya ce mai kyau. Ka kuma yi tunani ko za ka iya yin hasashe ba tare da gwaji ba ta amfani da dalilin.
y-m-01-02.s.s1.reflect: Da farko hasashena ya dogara da misali ɗaya kawai; imani na ya ƙaru yayin da misalai suka ƙaru, kuma da zarar na san dalilin na iya magana har game da manyan lambobi. y-m-01-05.title: Abokai nawa ne suke tsaye a layi gaba ɗaya?
y-m-01-05.topic: Lambobin matsayi da yawan gaba ɗaya (wuri nawa, mutane nawa gaba ɗaya)
y-m-01-05.goal: Koyi cewa “wace matsayi” da “mutane nawa” suna da ma'anoni mabambanta; yi amfani da gaskiyar cewa mutum guda yana cikin ƙirga daga gaba da daga baya domin gano bayanin da zai ba ka jimilla da wanda ba zai ba ka ba, sannan ka bambance yawan mutanen da ke tsakanin mutane biyu da bambancin lambobin matsayinsu.
y-m-01-05.material: Mutane suna tsaye a layi guda a gaban abin hawa na wurin shakatawa. Jihu yana matsayi na 5 daga gaba kuma na 4 daga baya. Seoha ta yi lissafi ta bayyana yawan mutanen da ke cikin layin gaba ɗaya.
y-m-01-05.thinking.0: Nemo kuskuren mafita ka gyara shi
y-m-01-05.thinking.2: Ƙirƙirar yanayi da dama da suka cika adadin mutanen da ke tsaye a tsakanin
y-m-01-05.prereq.0: Faɗin matsayi farko, na biyu, ... da ƙirga mutum ɗaya bayan ɗaya (matakin aji na 1)
y-m-01-05.prereq.1: Ƙirga lambobi har zuwa 12 da faɗin matsayinsu
y-m-01-05.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi layi na farko a bayanin Seoha da ba daidai ba.
y-m-01-05.s.s1.hint.0: Zana layin a matsayin akwatuna, yi alama a akwatin Jihu, sannan ka sanya lambobi daga gaba.
y-m-01-05.s.s1.hint.1: A hoton layin, yi alama da fensir masu launi mabambanta a guraben da ka ƙirga mutane 5 da guraben da ka ƙirga mutane 4, sannan ka ƙirga yawan guraben da aka yi wa alama gaba ɗaya.
y-m-01-05.s.s1.line.0: Jihu yana matsayi na 5 daga gaba da na 4 daga baya.
y-m-01-05.s.s1.line.1: Daga gaba zuwa Jihu mutane 5 ne, daga baya zuwa Jihu kuma mutane 4 ne.
y-m-01-05.s.s1.line.2: Idan ka haɗa mutane 5 da mutane 4, an ƙirga kowa sau ɗaya kawai, saboda haka mutane 9 ne.
y-m-01-05.s.s1.line.3: Saboda haka mutane 9 ne a cikin layin gaba ɗaya.
y-m-01-05.s.s1.explain: Layi na 2 daidai ne. Ƙirga daga gaba har zuwa Jihu ya ƙunshi mutane 5, tare da Jihu, kuma ƙirga daga baya har zuwa Jihu ma mutane 4 ne, tare da Jihu. y-m-01-11.s.s1.st.2.r.a: 99 ba 9 da aka tara sau 11 ba ne, ainihin samfurin 9×11 ne. Sake duba lissafin.
y-m-01-11.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Tsarin ya yi daidai har zuwa 9×9, amma ƙila ba zai yi daidai bayan haka ba

y-m-01-11.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Wannan tsarin ba shi da amfani. Ya kamata a yar da shi
y-m-01-11.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Gaskiyar cewa ya yi daidai a cikin teburin ninkawa har yanzu tana nan. Ka yi tunani a wane zangon za a iya amfani da shi.

y-m-01-13.title: Idan shekara ta canza, shekarun suna nan ninki biyu?
y-m-01-13.topic: Dangantaka idan lambobi biyu suna canzawa tare (bambancin shekaru)
y-m-01-13.goal: Fahimci cewa lamba ɗaya kasancewa ninki biyu na wata a wani lokaci ba ya nufin za ta ci gaba da kasancewa ninki biyu yayin da lokaci ke wucewa, sannan ka faɗi abin da yake nan daram idan lambobi biyu suna canzawa tare.
y-m-01-13.material: Jiu tana da shekara 6 a wannan shekara, shekarun ƙanenta ko ƙanwarta kuma 3 ne. Dukansu suna ƙara shekara ɗaya duk shekara. Jiu ta ce, “Shekaruna ninki biyu ne na na ƙanena ko ƙanwata. Don haka idan na kai shekara 12, shekarun ƙanena ko ƙanwata za su kai 6.”

y-m-01-13.thinking.2: Nemo abin da ya tsaya daram (bambancin shekaru)
y-m-01-13.prereq.0: Fahimtar shekaru da wucewar lokaci (ƙara shekara ɗaya a kowace shekara)

y-m-01-13.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi layi na farko a labarin Jiu da ba daidai ba.
y-m-01-13.s.s1.hint.0: Lissafa yawan shekarun da dole su wuce kafin Jiu ta kai shekara 12.
y-m-01-13.s.s1.hint.1: Ka yi tunani abin da zai faru da shekarun ƙanenta ko ƙanwarta cikin waɗannan shekarun.

y-m-01-13.s.s1.line.1: Shekarun Jiu ninki biyu ne na na ƙanenta ko ƙanwarta.
y-m-01-13.s.s1.line.2: Idan Jiu tana da shekara 12, shekarun ƙanenta ko ƙanwarta za su zama 6, wato rabin 12.

y-m-01-13.s.s2.hint.0: Daga wannan shekara (6 da 3), rubuta a jere shekarun kowannensu yayin da kowace shekara take wucewa.
y-m-01-13.s.s2.hint.1: A kowane layi na jadawalin shekaru, kwatanta bambancin shekarun mutanen biyun.

y-m-01-13.s.s2.fail.c3: Shekarun mutanen biyun ba su dace da dangantakar wannan shekarar ba. Sake duba yadda shekarunsu suka bambanta a wannan shekarar.
y-m-01-13.s.s2.explain: A duk lokacin da shekara ta wuce, mutanen biyun suna ƙara shekara ɗaya, saboda haka Jiu kasancewa ta fi ƙanenta ko ƙanwarta da shekara 3 ba ya canzawa. Suna zama nau'i-nau'i kamar 7 da 4, 9 da 6, da 12 da 9.
